goals: Build affirmative, negative and question sentences with です.
Connect nouns and describe possession, nationality and family.
Point to things and places, and choose an appropriate question word.
Choose あります or います for things, people and animals.
Describe a location and say what exists there.
Use position words and distinguish topic and subject particles.
Read numbers, prices and telephone numbers accurately.
Choose counters for people, objects, animals and age.
Ask about quantities and recognise irregular counter readings.
Tell the time and distinguish hours from minutes.
Read weekdays, calendar dates, months and years.
Use time expressions to say when something happens.
Distinguish a point in time from a length of time.
Describe durations and frequency.
Express approximate amounts and starting and ending points.
Distinguish い-adjectives and な-adjectives.
Describe nouns and connect descriptions.
Use affirmative, negative and past adjective forms.
Use the four polite verb endings for daily routines.
Describe when an action begins, ends or takes place.
Explain routines using time and manner expressions.
Describe actions and their objects with を.
Identify places, tools and recipients with the appropriate particles.
Ask and answer questions about everyday actions.
Describe destinations, origins and means of transport.
Say who accompanies you and how many people travel.
Recognise dictionary forms and use motion verbs in context.
Build verbs from nouns and する.
Use dictionary, negative, past and past-negative forms.
Choose casual or polite language to suit the situation.
chapters.note: Verb-group names: the book's numbered Groups 1–5 are 五段 verbs; its ‘Regular’ group is 一段. する and 来る are irregular. Follow the lesson's exception lists when choosing a conjugation.

goals: Use は and が with expressions of preference, ability and need.
Describe changes with なる and する.
Form potential verbs and distinguish 見える and 聞こえる.
Give reasons with から and ので, and ask why with なぜ, どうして and なんで.
Use question words with か, が and も, and add は to に, へ, で and と.
Invite with ましょう, ましょうか and ませんか, and describe the body with が.
Mark the target of verbs such as すむ, つく, のる and あう with に.
Make the stem (pre-ます) form, and say what you want or don't want to do with たい.
Say why you go somewhere with に いく, and do two things at once with ながら.
